literal_meaning: সরে যাওয়া (move aside or go away)
figurative_meaning_en: to part company or be separated from one's companion
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুরা সরে গিয়েছে, আর দেখা হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: The friends have parted ways and don't meet anymore.
Many people drift apart on the path of life.
note: This idiom reflects the transient nature of relationships in Bengali culture.
